summary: Example task backs up the Dell OS10 config with os10_config backup: yes and registers the location.
questions: How do I back up a Dell OS10 switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up Dell OS10 config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (dellos10)
  dellemc.os10.os10_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_dellos10_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'dellemc.os10.os10'
```
